title: TDR RadarView - Legacy Military Radar Telemetry Acquisition & TCP Relay
summary: Reverse-engineered telemetry acquisition and Plan Position Indicator (PPI) software replacing obsolete, non-functional military radar receiver computers by decoding raw RS-232 serial streams from the radar pedestal and relaying track vectors over TCP to upstream command systems.
highlights: Intercepted and decoded raw asynchronous RS-232 serial datastreams (4800 bps) from an operational military radar pedestal whose original receiver computer had suffered permanent hardware failure.
Engineered a real-time Plan Position Indicator (PPI) polar radar scope featuring range rings, azimuth sweep lines, georeferenced topographic maps, and Cartesian track coordinates.
Integrated a multi-threaded TCP server (Port 54321) relaying live target tracks (range, bearing, velocity, heading) to upstream battle management systems alongside a serial modem tactical chat link.
